OperatingIncome_Q.name: Operating Income Qtr
OperatingIncome_Q.detail: Operating Income is the earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) and is also synonymous with "operating profit" or "recurring profit." Operating income is calculated as (grossincome - operating expenses - depreciation - amortization).

OtherOperatingIncome_Q.name: Other Operating Income Qtr
OtherOperatingIncome_Q.detail: Other operating income is income that is from activities not related to the regular sales of goods and services. Other revenue is generated in the course of non-regular business operations.

SR_Q.name: Operating Revenue Qtr
SR_Q.detail: Revenue earned from the companyâs primary business operations during the most recent reported quarter, excluding non-operating income.

IntOrDiscOnAdvOrBills_Q.cat3: Int Or Disc On Adv Or Bills
IntOrDiscOnAdvOrBills_Q.name: IntOrDiscOnAdvOrBills Qtr

TOTAL_SR_Q.name: Total Revenue Qtr
TOTAL_SR_Q.detail: Total income from all business activities and sources earned during the latest reported quarter.

IncomeOnInvestment_Q.name: Income From Investment Qtr
IncomeOnInvestment_Q.detail: Income earned from interest payments, dividends, or capital gains collected upon the sale of a security or other assets, and any other profit made through an investment vehicle of any kind.

IntOnBalancesWithRBI_Q.cat3: Int On Balances With RBI Quarter
IntOnBalancesWithRBI_Q.name: Int On Balances With RBI Qtr
IntOnBalancesWithRBI_Q.sstr: Int On Balances With RBI Qtr
IntOnBalancesWithRBI_Q.lstr: Int On Balances With RBI Qtr
IntOnBalancesWithRBI_Q.detail: Income earned from interest payments, dividends, or capital gains collected upon the sale of a security or other assets, and any other profit made through an investment vehicle of any kind.

OI_Q.name: Other Income Qtr
OI_Q.detail: Other recurring income is that part of recurring revenue (repeating revenue that is stable and can be expected to continue in the future) that comes from sources not related to usual business practices

StockAdjustment_Q.name: Stock Adjustments Qtr
StockAdjustment_Q.detail: Stock or inventory adjustments are increases or decreases made in inventory to account for theft, loss, breakages, and errors in the amount or number of items received.The adjustments are made to match an item's actual on-hand quantity.

RawMaterialConsumed_Q.name: Raw Material Consumed Qtr
RawMaterialConsumed_Q.detail: The cost of raw material that the company requires to manufacture finished goods

PurchaseOfTradedGoods_Q.name: Purchase Of Traded Goods Qtr
PurchaseOfTradedGoods_Q.detail: All the purchases of finished goods that the company buys towards conducting its business

PowerAndFuel_Q.name: Power Plus Fuel Qtr
PowerAndFuel_Q.detail: Costs of power and fuel incurred by the company. This is a useful metric to track when the company shows production and revenue going up - power and fuel costs should also rise accordingly.

EmployeeExpenses_Q.name: Employee Expenses Qtr
EmployeeExpenses_Q.detail: Cost incurred for employee salaries and employee related costs. Employees include directors of the company.

Excise_Q.name: Excise Qtr
Excise_Q.detail: Costs of excise taxes levied on goods and commodities produced or sold within the country and on licences.

AdminAndSellingExpenses_Q.name: Admin Plus Selling Expenses Qtr
AdminAndSellingExpenses_Q.detail: Costs incurred from administrative and sales activities

ResearchAndDevlopmentExpenses_Q.name: RnD Expenses Qtr
ResearchAndDevlopmentExpenses_Q.detail: Costs incurred from research and development activities

ExpensesCapitalised_Q.name: Expenses Capitalised Qtr
ExpensesCapitalised_Q.detail: Costs that have been delayed in being recognized as such, due to company recognizing this as a long-term asset

OtherExpeses_Q.name: Other Expenses Qtr
OtherExpeses_Q.detail: Costs that don't fall in above categories and unrelated to usual business

ExceptionalItems_Q.name: Exceptional Items Qtr
ExceptionalItems_Q.detail: One time or uncommon expenses incurred by the business that is an especially large transaction

DEP_Q.name: Depreciation Qtr
DEP_Q.detail: A reduction in the value of an asset over time, due in particular to wear and tear

BankProvisionsMade_Q.name: Bank Provisions Made Qtr
BankProvisionsMade_Q.detail: Funds set aside by banks as per law. This includes provisions made each time a bank makes a loan, to cover the eventuality of that loan going into default. These are generic provisions. Specific provisions are also set up to cover loan defaults.

PL_After_TaxFromOrdineryActivities_Q.name: PAT From Ordinary Activities Qtr
PL_After_TaxFromOrdineryActivities_Q.detail: Profit or loss after taxes from ordinary activities

ExtraOrdinaryItem_Q.name: ExtraOrdinary Items Qtr
ExtraOrdinaryItem_Q.detail: An extraordinary item consists of the gains or losses included on a company's income statement from events that are unusual and infrequent in nature in current quarter. This amount is typically clarified in the notes accompanying financial statements.

PriorYearAdj_Q.name: Prior Year Adj Qtr
PriorYearAdj_Q.detail: A prior year adjustment can be one of the following two items: 1. The correction of an error in the financial statements that were reported for a prior period 2. Adjustments caused by the realization of the income tax benefits arising from the operating losses of purchased subsidiaries before they were acquired.

EQCAP_Q.name: Equity Capital Qtr
EQCAP_Q.detail: Invested money that, is not repaid to the investors in the normal course of business.It represents the capital staked by the owners through purchase of a company's common stock

ReservesAndSurplus_Q.name: Reserves Plus Surplus Qtr
ReservesAndSurplus_Q.detail: Reserves and surplus funds available to the company

CapitalAdequacyBaseII_Q.name: Capital Adequacy BaseII Qtr %
CapitalAdequacyBaseII_Q.detail: Capital Adequacy as Required by Basel norms

GrossNPA_Q.name: Gross NPA Qtr
GrossNPA_Q.detail: The sum of the values of all the NPAs of a company.

NetNPA_Q.name: Net NPA Qtr
NetNPA_Q.detail: The sum of the values of all the NPAs of the company with the provisions put aside. Simply put, Net NPA = Gross NPA - Provisions

ReturnOnAssets_Per_Q.name: RoA Qtr %
ReturnOnAssets_Per_Q.detail: An indicator of how profitable a company is relative to its total assets. It shows how efficient a company is in using its assets to generate earnings. This is the ROA% ROA = Net Income / Total Assets

AfterBasicEPS_Q.pname: Basic EPS After Extraordinary Current Quarter
AfterBasicEPS_Q.name: Basic EPS After ExtraOrdinary Qtr

AfterDilutedEPS_Q.pname: Diluted EPS After Extraordinary Current Quarter
AfterDilutedEPS_Q.name: Diluted EPS After ExtraOrdinary Qtr

ShareOfPLOfAssociates_Q.name: Share Of P&L From Associates Qtr
ShareOfPLOfAssociates_Q.sstr: Share Of P&L From Associates Qtr
ShareOfPLOfAssociates_Q.lstr: Share Of PL From Associates Qtr

NetPLAfterMIAssociates_Q.name: Net P&L After MI Associates Qtr
NetPLAfterMIAssociates_Q.sstr: Net P&L After MI Associates Qtr
NetPLAfterMIAssociates_Q.lstr: Net PL After MI Associates Qtr

EPS_adj_Q.name: Earning Per Share Adjusted latest Qtr
EPS_adj_Q.lstr: Earning Per Share Adjusted latest Qtr

LessExciseSeviceTaxOtherLevies_A.pname: Excise Service Tax Other Levies Current Annual
LessExciseSeviceTaxOtherLevies_A.name: Excise Service Tax Other Levies Annual
LessExciseSeviceTaxOtherLevies_A.sstr: Excise Service Tax Other Levies Ann.
LessExciseSeviceTaxOtherLevies_A.lstr: Excise Service Tax Other Levies Annual

InterestDiscountOnAdvancesBills_A.name: Interest Discount On Advances Bills Annual
InterestDiscountOnAdvancesBills_A.sstr: Interest Discount On Advances Bills Ann.
InterestDiscountOnAdvancesBills_A.lstr: Interest Discount On Advances Bills Annual

IncomeFromInvestments_A.name: Income From Investments Annual
IncomeFromInvestments_A.detail: Income earned from interest payments, dividends, or capital gains collected upon the sale of a security or other assets, and any other profit made through an investment vehicle of any kind.

InterestOnBalanceWithRBIAndOtherInterBan.cat3: Interest On Balance With RBI Plus InterBank Funds
InterestOnBalanceWithRBIAndOtherInterBan.name: Interest On Balance With RBI Plus Other InterBank Funds Annual
InterestOnBalanceWithRBIAndOtherInterBan.sstr: Interest On Balance With RBI Plus Other InterBank Funds Ann.
InterestOnBalanceWithRBIAndOtherInterBan.lstr: Interest On Balance With RBI Plus Other InterBank Funds Annual
InterestOnBalanceWithRBIAndOtherInterBan.detail: The interest earned on balances maintained with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and any other interbank transfer funds.

TotalOperatingRevenues_A.name: Operating Revenue Annual
TotalOperatingRevenues_A.detail: The total interests earned on a loan

OI_A.name: Other Income Annual
OI_A.detail: Income that is from activities not related to the regular sales of goods and services. Other revenue is generated in the course of non-regular business operations.

SR_A.name: Total Revenue Annual
SR_A.detail: Total income earned in a financial year from both operating and non-operating activities, before deducting any expenses.

INT_A.name: Interest Annual
INT_A.detail: Interest paid/payable on all types of deposits including deposits from banks and other institutions.

EmployeeBenefitExpenses_A.name: Employee Expenses Annual
EmployeeBenefitExpenses_A.detail: Cost incurred for employee salaries and employee related costs, including costs for provisions made to employees. Employees include directors of the company.

DEP_A.name: Depreciation
DEP_A.detail: A reduction in the value of an asset over time, due in particular to wear and tear

DepreciationOnLeasedAssets_A.name: Depreciation On Leased Assets Annual
DepreciationOnLeasedAssets_A.detail: The reduction in value on leased assets over time. Since an asset recorded through a lease is essentially no different from any other fixed asset, it must be depreciated in the normal manner, where periodic depreciation is based on a combination of the recorded asset cost, any salvage value, and its useful life

OperatingExpensesExcludesEmployeeCostAnd.cat3: Operating Expenses Excluding Employee Cost And Depreciation Annual
OperatingExpensesExcludesEmployeeCostAnd.name: Operating Expenses Excluding Employee Cost & Depreciation Annual
OperatingExpensesExcludesEmployeeCostAnd.sstr: Operating Exp. Excluding Employee Cost & Depreciation Ann.
OperatingExpensesExcludesEmployeeCostAnd.lstr: Operating Expenses Excluding Employee Cost & Depreciation Annual
OperatingExpensesExcludesEmployeeCostAnd.detail: The operating expenses prior to accounting the employee costs and depreciation.Operating expenses are those expenditures that a business incurs to engage in any activities not directly associated with the production of goods or services

OEXPNS_A.name: Operating Expenses Annual
OEXPNS_A.detail: The total expenses incurred in carrying out an organization's day-to-day activities, but not directly associated with production.Operating expenses include such things as payroll, sales commissions, employee benefits and pension contributions, transportation and travel, amortization and depreciation, rent, repairs, and taxes.

CurrentTax_A.name: Current Tax Annual
CurrentTax_A.detail: It is the estimated amount that a business expects to pay in income taxes for the current year. This amount is derived by adjusting the reported net income of a business with a variety of permanent and temporary differences

DeferredTax_A.name: Deferred Tax Annual
DeferredTax_A.detail: It is the estimated amount that a business expects to pay under deferred tax for the current year.The deferred income tax is a liability recorded on a company's balance sheet resulting from a difference in income recognition between tax laws and the company's accounting methods.

OtherDirectTaxes_A.name: Other Direct Taxes Annual
OtherDirectTaxes_A.detail: It is the estimated amount that a business expects to pay under other forms of tax, not including income tax and deferred tax for the current year.

OtherProvisionsAndContingencies_A.name: Other Provisions Plus Contingencies Annual
OtherProvisionsAndContingencies_A.detail: Amount of money set aside for other provisions and any expected contingencies

ProvisionsAndContingencies_A.name: Provisions Plus Contingencies Annual
ProvisionsAndContingencies_A.detail: The aggregate of all provisions and contingencies of a company.

LessInterUnitSegmentDivisionTransfer_A.cat3: Less Inter Unit Segment Division Transfer
LessInterUnitSegmentDivisionTransfer_A.name: Less Inter Unit Segment Division Transfer Annual
LessInterUnitSegmentDivisionTransfer_A.sstr: Less Inter Unit Segment Division Transfer Ann.
LessInterUnitSegmentDivisionTransfer_A.lstr: Less Inter Unit Segment Division Transfer Annual

LessTransferToFromInvestmentFixedAssetsO.cat3: Less Transfer To From Investment Fixed Assets
LessTransferToFromInvestmentFixedAssetsO.name: Less Transfer To From Investment Fixed Assets Others Annual
LessTransferToFromInvestmentFixedAssetsO.sstr: Less Transfer To From Investment Fixed Assets Others Ann.
LessTransferToFromInvestmentFixedAssetsO.lstr: Less Transfer To From Investment Fixed Assets Others Annual

LessAmountsTransferToCapitalAccounts_A.cat3: Less Amounts Transfer To Capital Accounts
LessAmountsTransferToCapitalAccounts_A.name: Less Amounts Transfer To Capital Accounts Annual
LessAmountsTransferToCapitalAccounts_A.sstr: Less Amounts Transfer To Capital Accounts Ann.
LessAmountsTransferToCapitalAccounts_A.lstr: Less Amounts Transfer To Capital Accounts Annual

LessShareOfLossFromPartnershipFirm_A.cat3: Less Share Of Loss From Partnership Firm
LessShareOfLossFromPartnershipFirm_A.name: Less Share Of Loss From Partnership Firm Annual
LessShareOfLossFromPartnershipFirm_A.sstr: Less Share Of Loss From Partnership Firm Ann.
LessShareOfLossFromPartnershipFirm_A.lstr: Less Share Of Loss From Partnership Firm Annual

TotalExpenses_A.name: Total Expenses Annual
TotalExpenses_A.detail: All expenses incurred by the company in the defined time period

PAT_A.name: PAT Before ExtraOrdinary Items Annual
PAT_A.detail: The net profit or loss for the year.All items of income and expense which are recognised in a year are included in the determination of the net profit or loss for the year.This includes extraordinary items and the effects of changes in accounting estimates.

PriorPeriodItems_A.name: Prior Period Items Annual
PriorPeriodItems_A.detail: Prior period items are income or expenses which arise in the current period as a result of errors or omissions in the preparation of the financial statements of one or more prior periods. The objective behind prior period items is to indicate the effect of such items on the current profit or loss.

ExtraordinaryItems_A.name: Extraordinary Items Annual
ExtraordinaryItems_A.detail: An extraordinary item consists of the gains or losses included on a company's income statement from events that are unusual and infrequent in nature. This amount is typically clarified in the notes accompanying financial statements.

ProfitLossBeforeExceptionalExtraOrdinary.cat3: Profit/Loss Before Exceptional Extraordinary Items And Tax Annual
ProfitLossBeforeExceptionalExtraOrdinary.name: ProfitLoss Before Exceptional ExtraOrdinary Items & Tax Annual
ProfitLossBeforeExceptionalExtraOrdinary.sstr: ProfitLoss Before Exceptional ExtraOrdinary Items And Tax Ann.
ProfitLossBeforeExceptionalExtraOrdinary.lstr: ProfitLoss Before Exceptional ExtraOrdinary Items And Tax Annual

NP_A.name: Net Profit Annual
NP_A.detail: Net profit or loss incurred for year after incorporating extraordinary income

ProfitLossBroughtForward_A.name: PL Brought Forward Annual
ProfitLossBroughtForward_A.detail: The profit/loss a company has brought forward from the prior year to the current year's financial statements.

TotalProfitLoss_A.name: Total Profit Loss Annual
TotalProfitLoss_A.detail: A common measure of the company's success and is equal to the net revenue remaining post deduction of all costs.

TransferToFromStatutoryReserve_A.name: Transfer To From Statutory Reserve Annual
TransferToFromStatutoryReserve_A.sstr: Transfer To From Statutory Reserve Ann.
TransferToFromStatutoryReserve_A.lstr: Transfer To From Statutory Reserve Annual
TransferToFromStatutoryReserve_A.detail: The amount a company transfers, out of the balance of profit as disclosed in the profit and loss statement, to the statutory reserve.

TransferToFromReserveFund_A.name: Transfer To From Reserve Fund Annual
TransferToFromReserveFund_A.sstr: Transfer To From Reserve Fund Ann.
TransferToFromReserveFund_A.lstr: Transfer To From Reserve Fund Annual
TransferToFromReserveFund_A.detail: The amount a company transfers, out of the balance of profit as disclosed in the profit and loss statement, to/from the reserve fund

TransferToFromSpecialReserve_A.name: Transfer To From Special Reserve Annual
TransferToFromSpecialReserve_A.sstr: Transfer To From Special Reserve Ann.
TransferToFromSpecialReserve_A.lstr: Transfer To From Special Reserve Annual
TransferToFromSpecialReserve_A.detail: The amount a company transfers, out of the balance of profit as disclosed in the profit and loss statement, to/from the special reserve created and maintained by a specified entity.

TransferToFromCapitalReserve_A.name: Transfer To From Capital Reserve Annual
TransferToFromCapitalReserve_A.sstr: Transfer To From Capital Reserve Ann.
TransferToFromCapitalReserve_A.lstr: Transfer To From Capital Reserve Annual
TransferToFromCapitalReserve_A.detail: The amount the company has transferred to the capital reserve. A capital reserve is a type of account on a company's balance sheet that is reserved for long-term capital investment projects or other large and anticipated expenses that will be incurred in the future. For a bank or another financial institution, a capital reserve is set up to meet regulatory requirements and acts as a buffer during adverse economic times or financial hardship.

TransferToFromInvestmentReserve_A.name: Transfer To From Investment Reserve Annual
TransferToFromInvestmentReserve_A.sstr: Transfer To From Investment Reserve Ann.
TransferToFromInvestmentReserve_A.lstr: Transfer To From Investment Reserve Annual
TransferToFromInvestmentReserve_A.detail: The amount the company has transferred to or from the investment reserve

TransferToFromRevenueAndOtherReserves_A.cat3: Transfer To From Revenue Plus Other Reserves
TransferToFromRevenueAndOtherReserves_A.name: Transfer To From Revenue Plus Other Reserves Annual
TransferToFromRevenueAndOtherReserves_A.sstr: Transfer To From Revenue Plus Other Reserves Ann.
TransferToFromRevenueAndOtherReserves_A.lstr: Transfer To From Revenue Plus Other Reserves Annual
TransferToFromRevenueAndOtherReserves_A.detail: The amount the company has transferred to or from revenue or other reserves

TaxForEarlierYears_A.pname: Tax For Earlier Years Annual Current
TaxForEarlierYears_A.name: Tax For Earlier Years Annual

PreferenceShareDividend_A.name: Preference Share Dividend Annual
PreferenceShareDividend_A.detail: The dividend amount paid to the holders of preferred stock.

TaxOnDividend_A.name: Tax On Dividend Annual
TaxOnDividend_A.detail: Tax imposed by the Indian Government on companies according to the dividend paid to a company's investors. This tax is paid out of the profits/reserves of the company declaring the dividend.

TotalAppropriations_A.name: Total Appropriations Annual
TotalAppropriations_A.detail: The total amount of money set aside by a company for a specific purpose. The money may be set aside for any of the functions of a business, including setting aside funds for employee salaries, research and development, dividends and all other uses of cash. This value give investors an idea of a company's future prospects.

EQCAP_A.name: Equity Share Capital Annual
EQCAP_A.detail: Invested money that, is not repaid to the investors in the normal course of business. It represents the capital staked by the owners through purchase of a company's common stock

PreferenceCapital_A.name: Preference Capital Annual
PreferenceCapital_A.detail: The Preference Capital is that portion of capital which is raised through the issue of the preference shares.

TotalShareCapital_A.name: Total Share Capital Annual
TotalShareCapital_A.detail: The summation of the equity capital and preference capital of the company.

RevaluationReserves_A.name: Revaluation Reserves Annual
RevaluationReserves_A.detail: The revaluation reserve is an accounting term used when a company has to enter a line item on its balance sheet due to a revaluation performed on an asset. This line item is used when the revaluation finds the current and probable future value of the asset is higher than the recorded historic cost of the same asset.

ReservesAndSurplus_A.name: Reserves Plus Surplus Annual
ReservesAndSurplus_A.detail: Reserves and surplus of the company

TotalReservesAndSurplus_A.name: Total Reserves Plus Surplus Annual
TotalReservesAndSurplus_A.detail: Total reserves and surplus of the company

MoneyAgainstShareWarrants_A.name: Money Against Share Warrants Annual
MoneyAgainstShareWarrants_A.detail: This is the money received by selling share warrants of the company. Share warrants are instruments that show the holder of the same has ownership of the shares of the company. The money on sale of shares shall be payable to the holder of the share warrant, irrespective of the fact whether the holder is the real holder or not.

EmployeesStockOptions_A.name: ESOPs Annual
EmployeesStockOptions_A.detail: The value a stock option granted to specified employees of a company. Employee Stock Options offer the options holder the right to buy a certain amount of company shares at a predetermined price for a specific period of time. A stock option is a privilege, sold by one party to another, that gives the buyer the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a stock at an agreed-upon price within a certain period of time.

TotalShareHoldersFunds_A.name: Total ShareHolders Funds Annual
TotalShareHoldersFunds_A.detail: Shareholders' funds is the balance sheet value of the shareholders' interest in a company. For company (as opposed to group) accounts it is simply all assets less all liabilities. For consolidated group accounts the the value of minority interests should also be excluded.

EquityShareApplicationMoney_A.name: Equity Share Application Money Annual
EquityShareApplicationMoney_A.detail: Money received by a company during an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for purchase of an equity share. Payments received for a subscription of an equity share is normally received over the IPO life. The amounts received would be carried as a current liability until such time as the stock is issued, then it would be considered as part of equity.

PreferenceShareApplicationMoney_A.name: Preference Share Application Money Annual
PreferenceShareApplicationMoney_A.detail: Money received by a company during an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for purchase of a preferred share.

Deposits_A.name: Deposits Annual
Deposits_A.detail: Total amount held by banks via deposits from account holders

Borrowings_A.name: Borrowings Annual
Borrowings_A.detail: The amount of money the company has borrowed. This will show up under liabilities within the balance sheet.

CL_A.name: Total Current Liabilities Annual
CL_A.detail: This typically covers liabilities such as small accounts payable, and liabilities and prioisions that do not incur interest and are to be paidover a period longer than one year.

TL_A.name: Total Capital Plus Liabilities Annual
TL_A.detail: The summation of total capital and total liabilities of the company. Total capital refers to the sum of long-term debt and total shareholder equity; both of these items can be found on the company's balance sheet. Total liabilities refer to the aggregate of all debts an individual or company is liable for and can be easily calculated by summing all short-term and long-term liabilities, along with any off balance sheet liabilities that corporations may incur.

CashAndCashEquivalents_A.name: Cash Plus Cash Equivalents Annual
CashAndCashEquivalents_A.detail: Cash and balances retained with the RBI.

BalancesWithBanksMoneyAtCallAndShortNoti.cat3: Balances With Banks Money At Call Annual
BalancesWithBanksMoneyAtCallAndShortNoti.name: Balances With Banks Money At Call Annual
BalancesWithBanksMoneyAtCallAndShortNoti.sstr: Balances With Banks Money At Call Ann.
BalancesWithBanksMoneyAtCallAndShortNoti.lstr: Balances With Banks Money At Call Annual
BalancesWithBanksMoneyAtCallAndShortNoti.detail: Balances retained by banks for emergency funds

Investments_A.name: Investments Annual
Investments_A.detail: Line within the balance sheet of the company which represents innvestments that management does not expect to sell within the year. These investments can include bonds, common stock, long-term notes, investments in tangible fixed assets not currently used in operations

Advances_A.name: Advances Annual
Advances_A.detail: Line within the balance sheet which represents the sums paid or received prior to the fulfillment of an obligation, such as supply of goods or provision of services.

FixedAssets_A.name: Fixed Assets Annual
FixedAssets_A.detail: Line within the balance sheet which represents the monetary value forth long-term tangible pieces of property that a company owns and uses in the production of its income and is not expected to be consumed or converted into cash any sooner than at least one year's time

OtherAssets_A.name: Other Assets Annual
OtherAssets_A.detail: Line within the balance sheet which represents assets which fall under a special classification for unusual items that cannot be included in one of the other asset categories. Examples include deferred charges (long-term prepaid expenses), non-current receivables and advances to subsidiaries.

TA_A.name: Total Assets Annual
TA_A.detail: This represents a summation of the current and long-term assets of a company. As per the accounting equation, total assets = total liabilities + shareholder's equity

CFO_A.name: Cash from Operating Activity Annual
CFO_A.detail: Cash from operating activities usually refers to the net cash inflow reported in the first section of the statement of cash flows. Cash from operating activities focuses on the cash inflows and outflows from a company's main business activities of buying and selling merchandise, providing services, etc.

CFI_A.name: Cash from Investing Activity Annual
CFI_A.detail: Value on the Cash Flow representing the aggregate change in a company's cash position resulting from any gains (or losses) from investments in the financial markets and operating subsidiaries and changes resulting from amounts spent on investments in capital assets such as plant and equipment.

CFA_A.name: Cash from Financing Annual Activity
CFA_A.detail: The item on the cash flow statement accounting for the inflows and outflows of cash resulting from debt issuance and financing, the issuance of any new stock, dividend payments, and any repurchase of existing stock.

ForeignExchangeGainsLosses_A.name: Forex Gains Losses Annual
ForeignExchangeGainsLosses_A.detail: The difference in value between the foreign currency assets and liabilities at the time they were recorded in the statement, and the value using the exchange rates at the time of the reporting of financial statements

NetIncDecInCashAndCashEquivalents_A.cat3: Net Increase In Cash Plus Cash Equivalents Annual
NetIncDecInCashAndCashEquivalents_A.name: Net Increase In Cash Plus Cash Equivalents Annual
NetIncDecInCashAndCashEquivalents_A.sstr: Net Increase In Cash Plus Cash Eqv.s Ann.
NetIncDecInCashAndCashEquivalents_A.lstr: Net Increase In Cash Plus Cash Equivalents Annual
NetIncDecInCashAndCashEquivalents_A.detail: The increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents from the beginning to the end of a year. It is equal to the net change in cash and cash equivalents as a result of the company's operating, investing and financing activities.

CashAndCashEquivalentBeginOfYear_A.cat3: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent Beginning Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentBeginOfYear_A.name: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent Begin Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentBeginOfYear_A.sstr: Cash Plus Cash Eqv. Begin Of Year Ann.
CashAndCashEquivalentBeginOfYear_A.lstr: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent Begin Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentBeginOfYear_A.detail: The value of cash and cash equivalents of the company recorded at the beginning of the current fiscal year.

CashAndCashEquivalentEndOfYear_A.cat3: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent End Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentEndOfYear_A.name: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent End Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentEndOfYear_A.sstr: Cash Plus Cash Eqv. End Of Year Ann.
CashAndCashEquivalentEndOfYear_A.lstr: Cash Plus Cash Equivalent End Of Year Annual
CashAndCashEquivalentEndOfYear_A.detail: The value of cash and cash equivalents of the company recorded at the end of the current fiscal year.

EPS_A.name: EPS Annual
EPS_A.detail: Basic EPS - Basic earnings per share represents the amount of a company's profit or loss for a reporting period that is available to the shares of its common stock that are outstanding during the reporting period. It is a useful measure of performance for companies with simplified capital structures.

DilutedEPS_A.name: Diluted EPS Annual
DilutedEPS_A.detail: A metric used in fundamental analysis to gauge a company's quality of earnings per share, assuming all convertible securities are exercised (including all outstanding convertible preferred shares, convertible debt, equity options and warrants)

NumberOfBranches_A.name: Number Of Branches Annual
NumberOfBranches_A.detail: The number of branches/facitlities a company has

NumberOfEmployees_A.name: Number Of Employees Annual
NumberOfEmployees_A.detail: Number of employees on payroll of the company

CapitalAdequacyRatios_A.name: Capital Adequacy Ratios Annual %
CapitalAdequacyRatios_A.detail: A measure of a bank's capital. It is expressed as a percentage of a bank's risk weighted credit exposures.The ratio is calculated using the following formula: CAR = (Tier 1 Capital + Tier 2 Capital)/Risk Weighed Assets

KeyPerformanceTier1_A.name: Key Performance Tier1 Annual %
KeyPerformanceTier1_A.detail: Metrics that place bank in Tier1 in terms of performance

KeyPerformanceTier2_A.name: Key Performance Tier2 Annual %
KeyPerformanceTier2_A.detail: Metrics that place bank in Tier2 in terms of performance

GrossNPARs_A.name: Gross NPA Annual
GrossNPARs_A.detail: The net NPA divided by the total advances of a branch reflects the gross NPA ratio. It measures the overall quality of the bank's loans.

NetNPARs_A.name: Net NPA Annual
NetNPARs_A.detail: The net NPA to loans (advances) ratio is used as a measure of the overall quality of the bank's loan book.

NetNPAToAdvancesPercentage_A.name: Net NPA To Advances Percentage Annual %
NetNPAToAdvancesPercentage_A.sstr: Net NPA To Advances Percentage Ann. %
NetNPAToAdvancesPercentage_A.lstr: Net NPA To Advances Percentage Annual %
NetNPAToAdvancesPercentage_A.detail: The net NPA to loans (advances) ratio is used as a measure of the overall quality of the bank's loan book. NPA ratio = Net non-performing assets / Loans given

ContingentLiabilities_A.name: Contingent Liabilities plus Commitments Annual
ContingentLiabilities_A.detail: The line within the balance sheet wihich represents the potential liabilities that may occur, depending on the outcome of an uncertain future event. A contingent liability is recorded in the accounting records if the contingency is probable and the amount of the liability can be reasonably estimated.

BonusEquityShareCapital_A.name: Bonus Equity Share Capital Annual
BonusEquityShareCapital_A.detail: Capital from additional shares given by the company to the current shareholders without any additional cost, based upon the number of shares that a shareholder owns.

IncomeMinorityInterest_A.name: Minority Interest Income Annual
IncomeMinorityInterest_A.detail: A minority interest, which is also referred to as noncontrolling interest (NCI), is ownership of less than 50% of a company's equity by an investor or another company. A proportional share of income shows up on the parent company's income statement attributable to the minority interest.

ShareOfProfitLossFromAssociate_A.cat3: Share Of Profit Loss From Associate Annual
ShareOfProfitLossFromAssociate_A.name: Share Of Profit Loss From Associate Annual
ShareOfProfitLossFromAssociate_A.sstr: Share Of Profit Loss From Associate Ann.
ShareOfProfitLossFromAssociate_A.lstr: Share Of Profit Loss From Associate Annual
ShareOfProfitLossFromAssociate_A.detail: The proportion of profit/loss within the company's financial statements attributable to Associate Company. An associate company, in a broad sense, is a corporation in which a parent company possesses a stake. Usually, the parent company only owns a minority stake in the associate company.

ProfitLossAfterMIAndAssociates_A.cat3: Profit/Loss After MI Plus Associates Annual
ProfitLossAfterMIAndAssociates_A.name: ProfitLoss After MI Plus Associates Annual
ProfitLossAfterMIAndAssociates_A.sstr: ProfitLoss After MI Plus Associates Ann.
ProfitLossAfterMIAndAssociates_A.lstr: ProfitLoss After MI Plus Associates Annual
ProfitLossAfterMIAndAssociates_A.detail: P&L post P&L attributed to Minority Interests and Associates

LiabilityMinorityInterest_A.name: Minority Interest Liability Annual
LiabilityMinorityInterest_A.detail: The noncurrent liability on the balance sheet of companies with a majority interest in a company, representing the proportion of its subsidiaries owned by minority shareholders.

PolicyHoldersFunds_A.name: Policy Holders Funds Annual
PolicyHoldersFunds_A.detail: The allocated (invested) portions of the premiums after deducting for all the charges and premium for risk cover in a particular fund

AssetMinorityInterest_A.name: Minority Interest Assets Annual
AssetMinorityInterest_A.detail: A portion of a subsidiary company that's owned by someone else.

PurchaseOfStockInTrade_A.cat3: Purchase Of Stock In Trade Annual
PurchaseOfStockInTrade_A.name: Purchase Of Stock In Trade Annual
PurchaseOfStockInTrade_A.sstr: Purchase Of Stock In Trade Ann.
PurchaseOfStockInTrade_A.lstr: Purchase Of Stock In Trade Annual

ChangesIninventoriesOfFGWIPAndStockInTra.cat3: Inventories Changes Of FGWIP Plus Stock In Trade Annual
ChangesIninventoriesOfFGWIPAndStockInTra.name: Inventories Changes Of FGWIP Plus Stock In Trade Annual
ChangesIninventoriesOfFGWIPAndStockInTra.sstr: Inventories Changes Of FGWIP Plus Stock In Trade Ann.
ChangesIninventoriesOfFGWIPAndStockInTra.lstr: Inventories Changes Of FGWIP Plus Stock In Trade Annual

CIFValueOfRawMaterials_A.cat3: CIF Value Of Raw Materials Annual
CIFValueOfRawMaterials_A.name: CIF Value Of Raw Materials Annual
CIFValueOfRawMaterials_A.sstr: CIF Value Of Raw Materials Ann.
CIFValueOfRawMaterials_A.lstr: CIF Value Of Raw Materials Annual

CIFValueOfStoresSparesAndLooseTools_A.cat3: CIF Value Of Stores Spares And Loose Tools Annual
CIFValueOfStoresSparesAndLooseTools_A.name: CIF Value Of Stores Spares & Loose Tools Annual

CIFValueOfOtherGoods_A.cat3: CIF Value Of Other Goods Annual
CIFValueOfOtherGoods_A.name: CIF Value Of Other Goods Annual
CIFValueOfOtherGoods_A.sstr: CIF Value Of Other Goods Ann.
CIFValueOfOtherGoods_A.lstr: CIF Value Of Other Goods Annual

CIFValueOfCapitalGoods_A.cat3: CIF Value Of Capital Goods Annual
CIFValueOfCapitalGoods_A.name: CIF Value Of Capital Goods Annual
CIFValueOfCapitalGoods_A.sstr: CIF Value Of Capital Goods Ann.
CIFValueOfCapitalGoods_A.lstr: CIF Value Of Capital Goods Annual

NetProfitLossFromDiscontinuingOperations.cat3: Net Profit From Discontinuing Operations Annual
NetProfitLossFromDiscontinuingOperations.name: Net Profit From Discontinuing Operations Annual
NetProfitLossFromDiscontinuingOperations.sstr: Net Profit From Discontinuing Operations Ann.
NetProfitLossFromDiscontinuingOperations.lstr: Net Profit From Discontinuing Operations Annual

LongTermLoansAndAdvances_A.cat3: Long Term Loans Plus Advances Annual
LongTermLoansAndAdvances_A.name: Long Term Loans Plus Advances Annual
LongTermLoansAndAdvances_A.lstr: Long Term Loans Plus Advances Annual

ShortTermLoansAndAdvances_A.cat3: Short Term Loans Plus Advances Annual
ShortTermLoansAndAdvances_A.name: Short Term Loans Plus Advances Annual
ShortTermLoansAndAdvances_A.lstr: Short Term Loans Plus Advances Annual

NonCurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.cat3: Non Current Investments Quoted Market Value Annual
NonCurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.name: Non Current Investments Quoted MarketValue Annual
NonCurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.sstr: Non Current Investments Quoted Market Value Ann.
NonCurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.lstr: Non Current Investments Quoted MarketValue Annual

NonCurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.cat3: Non Current Investments Unquoted Book Value Annual
NonCurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.name: Non Current Investments Unquoted BookValue Annual
NonCurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.sstr: Non Current Investments Unquoted Book Value Ann.
NonCurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.lstr: Non Current Investments Unquoted BookValue Annual

CurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.cat3: Current Investments Quoted Market Value Annual
CurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.name: Current Investments Quoted MarketValue Annual
CurrentInvestmentsQuotedMarketValue_A.sstr: Current Investments Quoted Market Value Ann.

CurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.cat3: Current Investments Unquoted Book Value Annual
CurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.name: Current Investments Unquoted BookValue Annual
CurrentInvestmentsUnquotedBookValue_A.sstr: Current Investments Unquoted Book Value Ann.

AdjustmentsOnAmalgamationMergerDemergerO.cat3: Adjustments On Amalgamation Merger Demerger Others Annual
AdjustmentsOnAmalgamationMergerDemergerO.name: Adjustments On Amalgamation Merger Demerger Others
AdjustmentsOnAmalgamationMergerDemergerO.sstr: Adj. On Amalgamation Merger Demerger Others
AdjustmentsOnAmalgamationMergerDemergerO.lstr: Adjustments On Amalgamation Merger Demerger Others

BasicEPS_A.name: Basic EPS Annual
BasicEPS_A.detail: Basic EPS - Basic earnings per share represents the amount of a company's profit or loss for a reporting period that is available to the shares of its common stock that are outstanding during the reporting period. It is a useful measure of performance for companies with simplified capital structures.

CEPS_A.name: Cash EPS Annual
CEPS_A.detail: A financial performance measure comparing cash flow to the number of shares outstanding. Also known as operating cash flow. Cash EPS = Operating Cash Flow/Diluted Shares Outstanding

BVSH_A.name: Book Value Per Share Annual
BVSH_A.detail: The book value per share not including the revaluation reserve. Book value per share is a measure used by owners of shares in a firm to determine the level of safety associated with each individual share after all debts are paid accordingly.

BVPerShareInclRevalReserve_A.cat3: Book Value Inc Reval Reserve Annual
BVPerShareInclRevalReserve_A.name: Book Value Inc Reval Reserve Annual
BVPerShareInclRevalReserve_A.sstr: Book Value Inc Reval Reserve Ann.
BVPerShareInclRevalReserve_A.lstr: Book Value Inc Reval Reserve Annual
BVPerShareInclRevalReserve_A.detail: The book value per share including the revaluation reserve.

DividendPerShare_A.name: Dividend Per Share Annual
DividendPerShare_A.detail: Sum of declared dividends issued by a company for every ordinary share outstanding. The figure is calculated by dividing the total dividends paid out by a business, including interim dividends, over a period of time by the number of outstanding ordinary shares issued.

NPAfterMIPerShare_A.cat3: Net Profit After MI Per Share Annual
NPAfterMIPerShare_A.name: Net Profit After MI Per Share Annual
NPAfterMIPerShare_A.sstr: Net Profit After MI Per Share Ann.
NPAfterMIPerShare_A.lstr: Net Profit After MI Per Share Annual

InterestIncomePerEmployee_A.name: Interest Income Per Employee Annual
InterestIncomePerEmployee_A.detail: Amount of interest that has been earned during a specific time period per employee of the company

NPPerEmployee_A.name: NP Per Employee Annual
NPPerEmployee_A.detail: Net profit per employee. It represents how productive the business is

InterestIncomePerBranch_A.name: Interest Income Per Branch Annual
InterestIncomePerBranch_A.detail: Amount of interest that has been earned per branch during a specific time period.

NPAfterMIMargin_A.cat3: Net Profit After MI Margin Annual
NPAfterMIMargin_A.name: Net Profit After MI Margin Annual %
NPAfterMIMargin_A.sstr: Net Profit After MI Margin Ann. %
NPAfterMIMargin_A.lstr: Net Profit After MI Margin Annual %

OPM_A.name: Operting Profit Margin Annual %
OPM_A.detail: Operating profit margin. A ratio which indicates how much profit a company makes after paying for variable costs of production such as wages, raw materials, etc. It is also expressed as a percentage of sales and then shows the efficiency of a company controlling the costs and expenses associated with business operations.It is calculated using the formula OPM = Operating income / Total revenue

ROA_A.name: RoA Annual %
ROA_A.detail: Return on assets. An indicator of how profitable a company is relative to its total assets. It provides an insight into how efficient a company's management is at using its assets to generate earnings and is displayed as a percentage. It is calculated using the formula ROA = Net Income / Total Assets

ROE_A.name: ROE Annual %
ROE_A.detail: Return on equity. The amount of net income returned as a percentage of shareholders equity. It measures a corporation's profitability by revealing how much profit a company generates with the money shareholders have invested. It is calculated using the formula ROE = Net Income/Shareholder's Equity

NIM_A.name: NIM Annual %
NIM_A.detail: Net interest margin. A ratio that measures how successful a firm is at investing its funds in comparison to its expenses on the same investments. Negative values denote that the firm hasn't made an optimal investment decision because interest expenses exceed the amount of returns generated by investments. It is calculated using the formula NIM = (Investment returns - interest expenses)/Average Earning Assets

CostToIncome_A.name: Cost To Income Annual %
CostToIncome_A.detail: A ratio which shows a company's costs in relation to its income. It is calculated using the formula Cost to Income Ratio = Operating Costs/Operating Income

InterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.name: Interest Income from Earning Assets Annual %
InterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.sstr: Interest Income from Earning Assets Ann. %
InterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.lstr: Interest Income from Earning Assets Annual %
InterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.detail: A ratio which is calculated by dividing the interest income by the average earning assets of the company.

NonInterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.cat3: Non Interest Income from Earning Assets
NonInterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.name: Non Interest Income from Earning Assets Annual %
NonInterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.sstr: Non Interest Income from Earning Assets Ann. %
NonInterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.lstr: Non Interest Income from Earning Assets Annual %
NonInterestIncomeByEarningAssets_A.detail: A ratio which is calculated by dividing the non-interest income by average earning assets of a company. Non-interest income is bank and creditor income derived primarily from fees

OperatingProfitByEarningAssets_A.name: Operating Profit from Earning Assets Annual %
OperatingProfitByEarningAssets_A.sstr: Operating Profit from Earning Assets Ann. %
OperatingProfitByEarningAssets_A.lstr: Operating Profit from Earning Assets Annual %

OperatingExpensesByEarningAssets_A.name: Operating Expenses from Earning Assets Annual %
OperatingExpensesByEarningAssets_A.sstr: Operating Expenses from Earning Assets Ann. %
OperatingExpensesByEarningAssets_A.lstr: Operating Expenses from Earning Assets Annual %

InterestExpensesByEarningAssets_A.name: Interest Expenses from Earning Assets Annual %
InterestExpensesByEarningAssets_A.sstr: Interest Expenses from Earning Assets Ann. %
InterestExpensesByEarningAssets_A.lstr: Interest Expenses from Earning Assets Annual %

EnterpriseValue_A.name: EnterpriseValue Annual
EnterpriseValue_A.detail: A measure of a company's total value, often used as a more comprehensive alternative to equity market capitalization. It is calculated using the formula EV = market value of common stock + market value of preferred equity + market value of debt + minority interest - cash and investments.

EVPerNetSales_A.name: EV Per Net Sales Annual
EVPerNetSales_A.detail: A valuation measure that compares the enterprise value (EV) of a company to the company's sales, giving investors a quantifiable metric of how much it costs to purchase the company's sales. It is calculated using the formula EV/Sales = (Market Capitalisation+Debt+Preferred Shares-Cash and Cash Equivalents)/Annual Sales

PriceToSales_A.name: Price To Sales Annual
PriceToSales_A.detail: A valuation ratio that compares a company's stock price to its revenue which is used as an indicator of the value placed on each dollar of a company's sales or revenues. It is calculated by using the formula P/S Ratio = Market Capitalisation/Total Sales (over a 12 month period)

RetentionRatios_A.name: Retention Ratio Annual %
RetentionRatios_A.detail: The proportion of earnings kept back in the business as retained earnings and is considered the opposite of Payout Ratio. It is calculated using the formula Retention Ratio = (Net Income - Dividends) / Net Income

EYield_A.name: Earnings Yield Annual
EYield_A.detail: A ratio which shows the percentage of each dollar/rupee invested in the stock that was earned by the company. Considered to be the inverse of the P/E ratio, it is used to to determine optimal asset allocations.

LTDE_A.name: Long Term Debt To Equity Annual
LTDE_A.lstr: Long Term Debt To Equity Annual

DEBT_CE_A.name: Total Debt to Total Equity Annual
DEBT_CE_A.sstr: Total Debt to Total Equity Ann.
DEBT_CE_A.lstr: Total Debt to Total Equity Annual

CFROA_A.name: Cash Flow Return on Assets Annual
CFROA_A.sstr: Cash Flow Return on Assets Ann.
CFROA_A.lstr: Cash Flow Return on Assets Annual

PBV_A.lstr: Price To Book Value Annual Adjusted
PBV_A.sstr: Price To Book Value Annual Adjusted
